notes: Corrected: the it of it is true is now its own added unit. The clause is verbless and the ki clause is its extraposed subject, so the pronoun is the anticipatory expletive rule 25 marks added, while the copula stays on the predicate adverb under rule 20. RUT.3.14's Let it be known is the other case, where a verb stands to be recast and rule 44 keeps the pronoun with it.
The verse writes two ki particles and the ASV one that; the that stands before the complement clause, so the second particle takes it and the first is unrepresented (rule 42's counting).
howbeit is given to the waw and the gam is unrepresented, since the one English word carries the coordination rather than the additive sense.
